d:
Jharkhand vidhanasbha men rajamhal vidhayak mo. tajuddin ne ek aham mudde ko lekar sarkar aur sanbandhit vyavastha par saval uthae. unhonne aarop lagaya ki logon ke nam kate ja rahe hain. aakhir kin logon ke nam kate ja rahe hain aur vidhayak ne sadan men is mudde ko kis tarah uthaya? dekhie is riport men puri khabra.
